title: Oportun Financial Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Oportun Financial Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Doug Bland as Chief Executive Officer, effective April 20, 2026, replacing the joint Office of the CEO structure held by Kathleen Layton and Gaurav Rana. Bland will receive a $750,000 base salary, $500,000 signing bonus, and a $5,000,000 equity award (50% RSUs, 50% PSUs).
key_points: Doug Bland appointed CEO and Class III director, effective April 20, 2026
Bland's compensation: $750,000 annual base salary, 125% target bonus opportunity
Signing bonus of $500,000 vesting in quarterly installments over one year, subject to continued employment
Equity award of $5,000,000 target value: 50% RSUs vesting over 3 years, 50% PSUs with 0-156% payout based on Economic ROA and TSR vs Russell 3000
Prior co-CEOs Kathleen Layton (now CLO) and Gaurav Rana (now SVP/GM Lending) departing joint CEO structure
Bland previously served as SVP & GM Consumer Business at PayPal (2017-2024) and President/COO of Swift Financial (2015-2017)
